note: The spring spine — the majors the racing hub counts down to. Times are UTC. Verified Aug 2026 against Racing Victoria's spring program (racing.com calendar), VRC, ATC and The Everest sites. The 2026 Cox Plate runs at Flemington while The Valley is offline for redevelopment. Update each winter.
